mashups.title: DogDesk
mashups.description: GNOME × Undertale: the small white dog from your own copy of Undertale lives on your GNOME desktop. It trots along your window tops, naps when you're away, notices notifications, sometimes absorbs a window you close, and keeps out of your way (never over fullscreen apps, and it dodges drags). Its sprites and music are read from your Undertale install; nothing from the game is included.

mashups.title: Hue Potato
mashups.description: Hue joins Brotato: play Hue Potato, a potato with Hue's hair, ear and eyes and Hue's colour wheel. Enemies, bullets, laser gates and skull boulders the colour of the background vanish. Earn Hue's colours wave by wave, hear Mum's letters, travel through Hue's regions with Hue's music, and fight with Hue's Laser Ring. Everything from Hue is read from your own copy of Hue.
